PANDA-PUSH(1)                   Panda CLI Manual                   PANDA-PUSH(1)

NAME
    panda push - apply local changes to Solutions

SYNOPSIS
    panda push [taskNumber|draft-N ...] [--json]

DESCRIPTION
    Check for remote conflicts, then send local task edits and staged actions to
    Solutions. Without selectors, push processes every task; with selectors, it
    processes only those tasks. Pending project catalogs are still synchronized.
    Local drafts can be pushed without a sync-state file; synced tasks require a
    baseline. --json emits per-task/catalog outcomes to stdout and still returns
    non-zero for failures. Requires a selected project and a successful login.

ARGUMENTS
    taskNumber|draft-N          Optional task selectors; repeat to push only those
                                tasks. Legacy local-* IDs are also accepted.

OPTIONS
    --json                      Emit a versioned JSON report. Per-task failures are
                                included in the report; the command still exits
                                non-zero.

EXAMPLES
    panda diff --verbose
    panda push
    panda push draft-1
    panda push draft-1 draft-3 --json

SEE ALSO
    panda-diff(1), panda-pull(1)
